sources.title: On Nonvanishing Univalent Functions with Real Coefficients
sources.author: Wolfram Koepf
sources.read: Full five-page extracted text through primary web tool; printed p578 freshly rendered and visually inspected
sources.exact_result: Section4 corollary classifies extreme points of normalized real-coefficient schlicht class and its closed convex hull via z/((1−gamma z)(1−conj(gamma)z)), |gamma|=1. Main paper also classifies nonvanishing-class support/extreme points.
sources.relation: Does not state a bound for f_double_prime/f_prime. A linear extreme-point theorem does not automatically optimize this nonlinear quotient. Submitted exact convex relaxation obstruction is relevant; no positive covering implication established from this source.

sources.title: Real Analogues of Pre-Schwarzian Univalence Criteria
sources.read: Full ten-page extracted text including definitions, Theorems1–2, corollary and references; no rendered-page verification performed
sources.relation: Studies sufficient univalence criteria on real intervals for complex-valued curves and their R^n extension; not the centered necessary distortion radius over the class of real-coefficient disk injections. No positive exact-target implication established. The word real in this title does not designate the target class.
